finding.description: Both scripts used assert for safety gates without rejecting optimized Python. -O/PYTHONOPTIMIZE removes PREDELETE/source/SHA/sibling/no-use assertions while the fixed unlink remains reachable.
finding.resolution: Ordinary if not __debug__: raise RuntimeError at module execution before imports/actions in both scripts; retirement helper SHA repinned. No other source delta.

reviewed_boundaries: Verified pinned helper bytes are compiled directly, without a second path-based load or bytecode cache write.
Fixed original parent is opened component-by-component without following symlinks; the source is one single-link regular leaf.
Actual source size/SHA/inode/mtime/ctime and all22 protected sibling paths/identities/hashes are checked before retirement.
Bounded /proc no-use inspection refuses on matching fd/mapping/cwd/exe, unexpected errors, permission failure, PID reuse or timeout.
Commit requires exact PREDELETE SHA and matching pointer/script/receipt/manifest hashes before exclusive durable COMMIT_STARTED.
Fresh remote checks retain the pinned private repository/release/asset identity and use prior complete authenticated payload readback honestly.
The sole unlink uses parent fd plus final parent/fd/path/member checks, with no intervening subprocess/external callback.
Imported transfer cleanup limits signals to its unreaped Popen child process group with original session/start identity checks; no foreign cleanup path.
Root must independently preserve/read back the exact pointer/scripts/receipt/manifest in Git before supplying the acknowledgement; the script does not attest a Git publication.
remaining_assumptions: Closed exclusive ownership remains necessary. A bounded no-use inspection is not an OS lock preventing a new writer after inspection; path-based unlink is not an atomic compare-inode-and-unlink primitive.
Successful preparation is not retirement; capacity is admitted only after actual committed retirement and fresh filesystem measurement.
conclusion: No additional demonstrated blocker in the reviewed revised source scope.
